import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm'
import { boolean, date, decimal, index, int, json, mysqlTable, serial, text, timestamp, varchar } from 'drizzle-orm/mysql-core'

export const users = mysqlTable('users', { id: serial('id').primaryKey() })
export const posts = mysqlTable('posts', { id: serial('id').primaryKey() })

export const comments = mysqlTable('comments', {
  id: int('id').primaryKey().autoincrement(),
  body: text('body').notNull(),
  postId: int('post_id').notNull().references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),
  createdAt: timestamp('created_at').notNull().default(sql`CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`),
}, (table) => [
  index('comments_post_id_index').on(table.postId),
])

export const tags = mysqlTable('tags', {
  id: int('id').primaryKey().autoincrement(),
  slug: varchar('slug', { length: 255 }).notNull().unique(),
  label: varchar('label', { length: 255 }).notNull().default('untitled'),
  weight: decimal('weight', { precision: 8, scale: 2 }),
  active: boolean('active').notNull().default(false),
  meta: json('meta'),
  ref: varchar('ref', { length: 36 }),
  seenOn: date('seen_on'),
  postId: int('postId').references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: 'set null' }),
  createdAt: timestamp('createdAt').notNull().default(sql`CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`),
}, (table) => [
  index('tags_ref_index').on(table.ref),
  index('tags_label_weight_index').on(table.label, table.weight),
])
